Meet Your Coach

Coach Anis

Anis is an internationally recognized chess coach and FIDE-rated player with over 12 years of competitive and coaching experience. Having trained students across 40+ countries, he brings a unique blend of classical theory and modern preparation techniques.

His teaching philosophy centers on building deep positional understanding, tactical sharpness, and psychological resilience — the three pillars of champion-level chess. Every student receives a customized roadmap tailored to their strengths and goals.

Preview Our Teaching Methodology

Watch Anis Teach — Before You Book

Real lessons from Anis’s own classes and tournament games. See how positions are broken down, mistakes are punished, and plans are built — exactly the way you’ll learn in your sessions. Tap any thumbnail to watch it big.

Opening Punishment • Game Analysis

Classical French Defense — Crush This Mistake

From a state championship game vs Krishna: one natural-looking mistake in the French, and the position collapses. Learn to spot and punish it.

Resilience • National 2023

French Steinitz — Won Despite a Wrong Opening

Sikandar Anis vs Bhudev Tripathi, National Championship 2023. The opening went wrong — the fight didn’t. A lesson in resilience and practical play.

Opening Masterclass • Sicilian

Sicilian Scheveningen — Part 1

Build a fighting repertoire for Black, step by step: pawn structure, key plans and the ideas behind one of the most respected Sicilian systems.
